entities.summary: Anniken Scharning Huitfeldt is a Norwegian politician and historian. She has served as the Norwegian Ambassador to the United States since 2024. A member of Labour Party, she has previously held several ministerial roles under Jens Stoltenberg between 2008 and 2013 and then served as foreign minister under Jonas Gahr Støre between 2021 and 2023.
